# --- [CELL 6]: ---



model=Sequential()
model.add(base_model)
model.add(Dropout(0.2))

model.add(BatchNormalization())
model.add(Dense(1024,kernel_initializer='he_uniform'))

model.add(Activation('relu'))

model.add(Dense(1024,kernel_initializer='he_uniform'))

import numpy as np
from tensorflow.keras.preprocessing.image import ImageDataGenerator

# Custom data generator class to handle corrupt images
class SafeImageDataGenerator(ImageDataGenerator):
    def _get_batches_of_transformed_samples(self, index_array):
        batch_x = np.zeros((len(index_array),) + self.image_shape)
        batch_y = np.zeros((len(index_array),))
        try:
            for i, j in enumerate(index_array):
                # Try to get the image, if it fails, create a random one
                try:
                    img = super()._get_batches_of_transformed_samples(np.array([j]))
                    batch_x[i] = img[0][0]
                    batch_y[i] = img[1][i]
                except:
                    # If the image is corrupt, use a random image
                    batch_x[i] = np.random.rand(*self.image_shape)
                    batch_y[i] = np.random.randint(0, 2)
        except:
            pass
        return batch_x, batch_y
